purpose: Verify the default MESH callback projects valid face boundaries to legacy addPolyline consumers without copying source identity or admitting malformed faces.

implementation.projection: one closed 3D POLYLINE per face with at least three vertices and all indices in range
implementation.coordinates: vertex XYZ copied to polyline vertex basePoint
implementation.identity: handle, parent handle, reactors, XDATA, and other source identity/ownership metadata are not copied

scopeLimit: Default legacy-consumer base-cage wireframe delivery only. Does not prove native MESH construction, subdivision-surface fidelity, independent interoperability, DWG producer semantics, or broad MESH support.
claimEffect: No format or native-consumer support claim changes.
